## Summary

Describe the purpose and scope of this pull request.

## Verification

List the checks performed and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is clear and changes are focused.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, or environment files are committed.
- [ ] No unintended source or generated-file changes are included.
- [ ] Arabic/English localization and RTL/LTR behavior were considered.
- [ ] Authentication and access control were considered, if relevant.
- [ ] SEO and sitemap behavior were considered for route or content changes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for UI changes.

## Notes for Reviewers

Call out important decisions, risks, migrations, deployment considerations, or areas that need focused review.
